snippet.title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Magical Library DLC - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4734690/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions__Magical_Library_DLC

The Magical Library expansion invites you into an arcane sanctuary overflowing with magical books, enchanted artifacts, and new Spirits to discover. 

Master the basics of magic by studying dusty grimoires in the grand archives, or spend quiet moments bonding with your Spirit companion, curled up among piles of books.

Join our cozy community!
https://discord.gg/spiritcitylofi
https://www.tiktok.com/@spiritcitylofi
https://www.instagram.com/spiritcitylofi/
https://x.com/spiritcitylofi
https://bsky.app/profile/spiritcitylofi.bsky.social

Music: Cosmic Drift · Team Astro
Label: Lofi Records
